customers_say: Customers find the water purifier to be among the best in its category, with reliable performance and quick, professional installation by Aquaguard experts. They appreciate its elegant design, good taste, and efficient purification capabilities, considering it good value for money. The service aspect receives mixed reviews, with some customers praising the excellent service while others report poor service experiences.

reviews.author: Ani
reviews.title: Very much satisfied with the purifier
reviews.body: It has only been a few days, and the product looks very promising. The installation team also did a great job. We had a slightly unconventional setup: the RO unit was placed in our wash area, and we connected the purified water outlet to a spout in the kitchen to dispense the RO water. Initially, the technicians were hesitant because they didn't fully understand how to execute the setup, but they later agreed and finished the installation with a neat and professional finish the next day. I was also able to connect the RO to the internet successfully. The TDS reading displayed in the app differ

reviews.title: Reasonably priced product
reviews.body: Amazing machine with a classy look. Technician was very professional. TDS meter provided with the machine is very useful

reviews.author: Harish
reviews.title: Great water purifier with no installation help
reviews.body: Super easy to operate day-to-day and delivers impressive TDS numbers. The only real trade-off is that you can't rely on professional installer support, so you have to handle the setup and maintenance yourself. Overall, highly recommended if you don't mind spend extra for installation to get actual professional help
